name: Fathom
description: Fathom lets agents search recorded meetings and read their summaries, transcripts, and action items in the signed-in Fathom account. Each user signs in to their own Fathom account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize my last customer call and list the action items.
Find the meetings this month where pricing came up.
Draft a follow-up email from yesterday's meeting with the design team.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.description: Meeting search, summaries, transcripts, and action items, over Fathom's MCP server with browser sign-in.
